assumptions: Only hypotheses explicitly present in the frozen official statement and the selected accepted branch are admitted.
Finite computation, restricted models, conditional lemmas and special cases do not close the universal root statement.
Statement-faithfulness and current-status review must close before Result admission.

definitions.definition: A solution satisfying the regularity, equation, divergence-free condition, initial condition and boundedness/decay clauses of the selected official branch for all nonnegative time.
Nonexistence of a globally smooth solution under one of the official counterexample branches, with all branch hypotheses satisfied.

domain.description: Clay/Fefferman 官方陈述中的三维不可压 Navier–Stokes 方程，在 R³ 或三维周期空间上的允许初值、外力与解。
objects: the R³ and periodic settings in the official statement

quantifiers.domain: one of the four closure alternatives (A)–(D) in the official Clay statement

sources.source: Clay Mathematics Institute official problem descriptions

statement.text: 针对三维不可压 Navier–Stokes 方程，按 Charles L. Fefferman 的 Clay 官方陈述闭合以下任一分支：在 R³ 上对满足规定光滑性、散度为零和衰减条件的初值且外力为零证明全局光滑解存在；在三维周期空间对光滑散度为零初值且外力为零证明全局光滑解存在；或在官方允许的 R³/周期设置中构造满足规定光滑与有界条件的初值和外力，使全局光滑解不存在。弱解存在、二维结论、特殊对称解或离散数值爆破均不能替代这些接受分支。

title: Navier–Stokes 方程存在性与光滑性
